title: Taiwanese Student Association at UCLA
content_html:
The Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at UCLA is a student organization dedicated to uniting the Taiwanese community on campus. Founded in 1988, TSA is one of the longer-standing Taiwanese student groups at the university. Its stated mission is to gather Taiwanese people, host events related to Taiwanese cultures and traditions, and help Taiwanese students integrate into UCLA life across both cultural and academic dimensions. The organization’s email address (ucla.tsa.1988@gmail.com) and a 2025 ASUCLA publication both reference the 1988 founding year.

TSA maintains an active Instagram presence under the handle @ucla.tsa, which carries the Chinese-language identifier UCLA 台灣學生會, and is listed as an active organization in UCLA’s official Community club directory (community.ucla.edu/studentorg/2413). Programming includes traditional holiday celebrations such as Lunar New Year and the Lantern Festival, socials, and collaborations with other cultural organizations on campus. TSA has also participated in joint productions with TASA, including a 2022 Taiwanese Culture Night performance.
